full_text:
Substrate AI wins a contract from the Government of the City of Buenos Aires to deploy Serenity Star on BAX and accelerate the digital transformation of the administration
by Substrate AI | Jul 6, 2026 | Press
Serenity Star will be the technology platform that will drive BAX, the artificial intelligence assistant of the Government of the City of Buenos Aires, and new cases of use of AI in management administration.
Madrid, 3 de julio de 2026. Substrate Artificial Intelligence, S.A. (BME Growth: SAI) anuncia la adjudicación de un contrato por parte del Gobierno de la Ciudad de Buenos Aires para la implantación de Serenity Star , la plataforma de inteligencia artificial empresarial de la compañía, como tecnología base para BAX, el nuevo asistente inteligente del Gobierno, y para la incorporación de inteligencia artificial en distintos procesos administrativos.
The project will enable the Government of the City deploy agents of artificial intelligence capable of improve both the service provided to the citizens and operational efficiency of the administration through the automation of tasks, document analysis and intelligent support for public sector employees.
One of the first areas in which Serenity Star will begin to add value will be the area of Urban Development , where the platform will incorporate artificial intelligence into the processing of planning applications urban planning. The agents developed on Serenity Star will carry out an initial analysis of of the documentation submitted by the citizens and professionals, identifying documentation that is incomplete, inconsistencies or possible issues before the before the file reaches the technician in charge.
The platform will then analyse the plans and technical documentation, checking them against current planning regulations and codes to produce a preliminary technical report that will facilitate the analysts’ work. This process will significantly reduce manual errors, streamline administrative procedures and shorten decision-making times.
Thanks to Serenity Star, the role of the technician will evolve from manually reviewing entire files to one of supervising and validating the analyses carried out by artificial intelligence. In this way, professionals will be able to focus their time on those cases that require technical judgement, regulatory interpretation and specialist analysis, thereby increasing productivity and improving the quality of decisions.
In addition to the area of Urban Development Urban Development, Serenity Star will be the technological platform on which BAX will evolve, the smart assistant of the Government of the City of Buenos Aires, which will enable citizens and businesses to carry out enquiries regarding administrative procedures, regulations, public services and other administrative information using natural language, providing answers available 24 hours a day.
The Serenity Star platform has been designed to create, deploy and manage artificial intelligence agents within complex organisations, integrating language models, document repositories and
corporate systems within a secure, scalable and fully traceable environment. Its architecture allows new use cases to be incorporated quickly, facilitating the digital transformation of public bodies and large
companies.
With this award, Substrate AI strengthens its international expansion and consolidates Serenity Star as one of the platforms for benchmark for the implementation of artificial intelligence in public administrations, demonstrating how AI can improve simultaneously the service provided to citizens and the efficiency of the internal processes within the public sector.
